items.description: One row of the patterns section: a regular language over cell values, compiled once to a deterministic table the $match: operand runs allocation-free, one indexed step per token.

name.description: The pattern name a rule references.

kind.description: The numeric kind of the values the word is read from: Int or Fixed.

items.description: One symbol of a pattern's alphabet: the cell values in Min..Max (inclusive, in the pattern's kind) read as this letter. Symbols may overlap; the refined alphabet splits them.

name.description: The symbol name a pattern node references.

min.description: The least value the symbol accepts.

max.description: The greatest value the symbol accepts.

attribute.description: For a zone source, the keyed row (over the zone's token domain) whose cell values form the word, in pile order; null reads the source row's own cell values.

maxStates.description: The machine-state budget the compile refuses past, 1..256.
